newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-NOAH UNHAPPY WITH DAVIS CUP FINAL VENUE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-NOAH UNHAPPY WITH DAVIS CUP FINAL VENUE.

text.p: France's captain Yannick Noah is unhappy with the former warehouse in which Sweden is hosting this weekend's Davis Cup tennis final.

"I have nothing to say against the quality of the court but this hall is a veritable scandal, it's not the place to play a Davis Cup final," Noah told French reporters at practice sessions on Wednesday.
The 5,500-capacity hall is among a row of former warehouses now called Malmomassan -- Malmo expositions park -- behind the docks on the site of an old car factory.
The Swedish hosts wanted to stage the final in Bolange, where there is a 10,000-capacity stadium, but the International Tennis Federation (ITF) pressed for a venue close to an international airport.
Malmo, Sweden's third city, is a half-hour ferry ride away from Copenhagen.
